name: planning-paraphrase-v1
description: Requests phrased without the keyword parser's vocabulary. Measures what an LLM provider adds; the offline provider is expected to refuse most of these (unknown machine kind). Written 7 Nov 2026 before any model was run on them.

cases.request: little warehouse runner that carries totes, 20 ms loop, top speed 0.8 m/s
autonomous tugger for hospital corridors, 1.1 m/s max, 25 ms cycle
two-wheeled delivery cart, 50 ms tick, cap it at 0.5 m/s
parcel sorting line moving boxes at 1.5 m/s, 10 ms period
baggage carousel at the airport, 0.6 m/s, 40 ms
roller transport line for pallets, 30 ms control loop, 0.9 m/s
pick-and-place manipulator, 15 ms servo loop, tool speed 0.7 m/s
six-axis welding cobot, 20 ms period, end effector 0.4 m/s
